units.source_text: 我是三宫市近郊的弹寺弟子，天生一双X型的腿……

en.t: I am a disciple at Dandera Temple near Sannomiya City, born with a pair of X-shaped legs...

units.source_text: 瞧，我就这样开始了自白，也许你以为我是个不择对象就随便讲自己遭遇的可怜的病人，

en.t: Look, this is how I begin my confession; perhaps you think I am some pitiful invalid who tells his story to anyone at all,

units.source_text: 可我不是对谁都说这番话的。

en.t: but I do not say these things to just anyone.

units.source_text: 我本人也觉得这是很难为情的，从一开始就选择你作为我倾吐衷肠的对象。

en.t: I myself find it very embarrassing that, from the very beginning, I chose you as the person to whom I would pour out my heart.

units.source_text: 因为我总觉得我的经历对你最有价值，

en.t: For I have always felt that my experiences would be of the greatest value to you,

units.source_text: 假使你按照我经历过的道路走，也许是最好的途径。

en.t: and that if you follow the path I have gone through, it may be the best way.
You have probably realized this by now,

units.source_text: 宗教家就是这样嗅出他的信徒，禁酒家就是这样嗅出他的同伙的。

en.t: this is how a religious man sniffs out his believers, and how a temperance advocate sniffs out his own kind.
